tldr: 台股大漲439點收46,288點，台積電漲1.89%領軍。
外資終結連5賣，單日買超121.85億元。
鴻海AI伺服器市佔逾40%，CPO交換機第3季量產出貨。

items.title_zh: 台積電領軍 台股大漲439點收46,288點
items.title_en: TAIEX jumps 439 points as TSMC leads relief rally
items.summary_zh: 台股9月17日終場收46,288點，上漲439.1點、漲幅0.95%，成交量回升至約8,100億元。權值王台積電收2,425元、上漲45元（+1.89%），為指數上攻主力。分析師指出，聯準會利率決議符合預期，帶動利空出盡的短線反彈，但單日反彈不代表修正結束，後續須觀察資金是否重返半導體族群。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark TAIEX closed at 46,288 on Sept 17, up 439.1 points (+0.95%), with turnover rebounding to about NT$810 billion. TSMC rose 1.89% to NT$2,425, adding NT$45 and anchoring the advance. The gain followed a Fed rate decision that matched expectations, sparking a short-covering bounce, though analysts cautioned the single-day rebound does not confirm the correction is over.

items.title_zh: 外資終結連5賣 三大法人買超214.77億
items.title_en: Foreign investors end five-day selling streak with NT$121.85bn buy
items.summary_zh: 9月17日集中市場三大法人合計買超214.77億元，其中自營商買超15.78億、投信買超77.14億、外資及陸資買超121.85億，外資終結連5個交易日賣超。法人買超前五名出現友達、力積電、聯電等面板與半導體股，顯示資金從高評價族群轉進低評價族群，市場輪動跡象明顯。
items.summary_en: Institutional investors turned net buyers of NT$21.48 billion on Taiwan's main board on Sept 17: dealers bought NT$1.58bn, investment trusts NT$7.71bn, and foreign/mainland funds NT$12.19bn, snapping a five-session selling run. Top net-buy names included AUO, Powerchip and UMC, suggesting rotation from richly-valued leaders into lower-valuation panel and chip stocks.

items.title_zh: 鴻海AI伺服器市佔逾40% CPO交換機Q3量產
items.title_en: Hon Hai's AI-server share tops 40%, CPO switches enter Q3 mass production
items.summary_zh: 鴻海表示AI伺服器布局進入收穫期，市佔逾40%，涵蓋GPU、CPU、ASIC等多元架構的伺服器與機櫃產品線，2026年機櫃出貨量估倍數成長並逐季遞增，CPO（共同封裝光學）交換機第3季進入量產出貨。受惠雲端網路產品強勁拉貨，8月營收達約9,218億元維持高檔，第3季能見度升溫。
items.summary_en: Hon Hai (Foxconn) says its AI-server business has entered a harvest phase, with market share above 40% spanning GPU, CPU and ASIC server and rack products. Rack shipments are expected to grow multiples in 2026 and rise quarter by quarter, while co-packaged-optics (CPO) switches begin volume shipment in Q3. August revenue reached about NT$921.8bn on strong cloud-networking demand.

items.title_zh: AI熱潮擴散 彭博估台企今年獲利增50%
items.title_en: Bloomberg sees Taiwan corporate profits up 50% as AI boom broadens
items.summary_zh: 彭博預估台灣企業今年獲利成長約50%，幾近2025年底預估18%的三倍，分析師持續上修台股獲利預測。受惠範圍從台積電、鴻海等大型權值股，擴散至中型科技股。AI題材由GPU、AI伺服器，進一步延伸到整櫃式伺服器、液冷散熱、PCB／CCL、電源供應、HBM／CoWoS與CPO／矽光子等供應鏈，帶動族群輪動。
items.summary_en: Bloomberg estimates Taiwanese corporate earnings will grow about 50% this year, nearly triple the 18% projected at end-2025. Analysts keep raising forecasts, and the benefit is spreading beyond large caps like TSMC and Hon Hai to mid-cap tech. The AI theme has widened from GPUs and servers to rack systems, liquid cooling, PCB/CCL, power supply, HBM/CoWoS and CPO/silicon photonics.

items.title_zh: 金管會8項新制上路 壽險業迎IFRS 17大轉型
items.title_en: FSC's eight new 2026 rules bring life-insurance overhaul via IFRS 17, ICS
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布2026年8大新制，明年元旦起壽險業接軌國際財務報導準則第17號（IFRS 17）與新一代清償能力制度（ICS）。IFRS 17以公允價值衡量保險負債，將對負債評估產生結構性影響，促使業者加強資產負債管理，財報表達可更貼近實質經營績效，為壽險業帶來會計與資本雙重轉型。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has outlined eight new measures taking effect Jan 1, headlined by life insurers adopting IFRS 17 and the new-generation solvency regime (ICS). IFRS 17 measures insurance liabilities at fair value, structurally reshaping liability valuation and pushing insurers to strengthen asset-liability management, with financial statements expected to better reflect underlying operating performance.

items.title_zh: 金控股利創高 13家現金股息總額3,422億
items.title_en: Listed financial holdings' cash dividends hit record NT$342.2bn
items.summary_zh: 全台13家上市金控及主要銀行股2026年股利政策全數公告，現金股息總額達3,422億元、改寫新高。富邦金（2881）改採全現金政策、配發4.25元，終結多年配股慣例；國泰金（2882）配息3.5元、逼近歷史新高。在2026年獲利動能強勁支撐下，金融股兼具防禦與殖利率題材，配息展望正面。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's 13 listed financial holding companies and major bank stocks have all announced 2026 dividend policies, with total cash dividends reaching a record NT$342.2 billion. Fubon Financial (2881) shifted to an all-cash payout of NT$4.25, ending years of stock dividends, while Cathay Financial (2882) declared NT$3.5, near a record, underpinning the sector's yield appeal amid strong 2026 profit momentum.

items.title_zh: 9月新基金募集潮 5檔登場、ETF占3檔
items.title_en: September fund-raising wave: five new funds, three of them ETFs
items.summary_zh: 投信新基金募集熱潮延續至9月，統計至月底還有5檔新基金陸續募集，其中ETF占3檔。2檔主動式ETF分別為鎖定台股核心50強的主動群益核心50（00415A），及聚焦台、韓、日半導體的主動安聯亞半導體（00412A）；另有街口特選優息非投資等級債券ETF（00992B）。主動式與債券型並進，反映投資人對台股核心資產與收益型商品需求同步升溫。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's fund-launch momentum continues into September, with five new funds opening for subscription through month-end, three of them ETFs. Two are active ETFs — Capital's active "Core 50" (00415A) targeting Taiwan blue chips, and Allianz's active Asia semiconductor fund (00412A) focused on Taiwan, Korea and Japan chipmakers — alongside JKO's selected high-yield non-investment-grade bond ETF (00992B).

items.title_zh: 高資產客群年增約7% 銀行搶財管商機
items.title_en: High-net-worth client base growing ~7% a year as banks race for wealth mandates
items.summary_zh: 研究指出，台灣高資產客群年複合成長率約7%，2025至2029年間可望提升至約10%，其中十億元以上超高資產客群成長最快、達約11%。銀行積極布局高端財管，中信銀行歡慶60周年，即日起至9月30日推出結合財管鼎鑽卡的專屬回饋，提供層峰禮遇與升等尊享，鎖定首富家以上客戶，反映財管市場競爭白熱化。
items.summary_en: Studies put the compound annual growth of Taiwan's high-net-worth segment at about 7%, accelerating toward roughly 10% for 2025-2029, with the ultra-high-net-worth (NT$1bn+) tier growing fastest at ~11%. Banks are intensifying premium wealth offerings; CTBC, marking its 60th anniversary, is running exclusive card-linked rewards and privileges for its top-tier clients through Sept 30.
